caption: An inflated balloon is squeezed between two palms; it flattens between the hands and bulges out at the sides, then rounds out again when the hands let go.

sa.check: An inflated balloon is held between two palms.
It bulges out at the sides.
It rounds out again when the hands let go.
The squeeze comes first, then the flatten and bulge, then the release.

pc.expect: The balloon flattens where pressed and bulges where not, keeping roughly the same overall size, and rounds out on release.
pc.fail: It stays flat after the hands open; or it shrinks as if deflating while squeezed; or it does not deform at all.

pc.expect: It stays one balloon and does not pass through the hands or burst.
pc.fail: The hands pass through the balloon; or it bursts and reforms; or it splits into two balloons.

pc.expect: The balloon changes only while the hands act and is still afterward.
pc.fail: It pulsates on its own; or flies off; or deforms before the hands close.

pc.expect: Released, it stays in the hands or drops slowly.
pc.fail: It shoots away like a jet; or rises steadily to the ceiling with nothing holding it; or hangs in mid-air away from the hands.
The balloon vanishes or a second appears; or it turns into another object; or it merges with a hand.

pc.expect: The balloon's colour and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The balloon changes colour; or the hands change; or the background rearranges.
